details.summary: Split the monolithic cache.py module into focused submodules: constants for shared values, core for the base Cache class, and separate files for each specialized cache class. Use __init__.py for re-exports to preserve all public APIs and ensure existing imports continue working. This groups by responsibility (utilities for constants, core caching logic, and domain-specific caches) while keeping each module under 200 lines.
